verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-protection platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-order API retrieval of fraud decisions and a general REST API. There is no documented bulk export of account data in open formats and no offboarding path. Per-order retrieval is at most a developer building block, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
